title: The Book of Malachi Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Malachi — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.
verses.decoded: This is the message from the LORD to Israel, delivered through Malachi.

verses.kjv: I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob,
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'I have loved you,' but you ask, 'How have you loved us?' Was not Esau Jacob's brother? Yet I chose Jacob and loved him.

verses.kjv: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
verses.decoded: But I rejected Esau and destroyed his land, leaving it desolate and wild.

verses.kjv: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.
verses.decoded: Edom says, 'We are poor, but we will rebuild our ruined towns.' But the LORD of hosts says, 'They may rebuild, but I will destroy. They will be called the border of wickedness, the people the LORD is always angry with.'

verses.kjv: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The Lord will be magnified from the border of Israel.
verses.decoded: You will see it for yourselves and say, 'The LORD is honored even beyond Israel's borders.'

verses.kjv: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the Lord of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
verses.decoded: A son respects his father, and a servant respects his master. So if I am your Father, where is my respect? If I am your Master, where is your fear? says the LORD of hosts to you priests who insult my name. And you ask, 'How have we insulted you?'

verses.kjv: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the Lord is contemptible.
verses.decoded: You bring defiled food to my altar and ask, 'How have we defiled you?' By saying, 'The LORD’s altar is worthless.'

verses.kjv: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: If you offer blind animals as sacrifices, isn’t that wrong? What about offering lame or sick ones? Try giving those to your governor—would he accept them or be pleased? says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: Now, please ask God to be kind to us—this has happened because of you. Will He accept your offerings? says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the Lord of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
verses.decoded: Is there anyone among you who would close the temple doors for no reason? You don’t even light the fire on my altar without a purpose. I am not pleased with you, says the LORD of hosts, and I will not accept your offerings.

verses.kjv: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: From sunrise to sunset, my name will be honored among the nations. Everywhere, pure offerings and incense will be presented to my name, for I will be great among the peoples, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the Lord is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.
verses.decoded: But you have defiled it by saying, 'The LORD’s altar is defiled,' and by treating what is offered as something worthless.

verses.kjv: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the Lord of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: You say, 'This is tiresome!' and you treat the offerings with contempt, says the LORD of hosts. You bring animals that are torn, lame, or sick as sacrifices. Should I accept that from you? says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the Lord of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.
verses.decoded: Cursed is the deceiver who, having a male animal in his flock, vows to give it to the LORD but then sacrifices something defective instead. I am a great King, says the LORD of hosts, and my name is feared among the nations.

verses.kjv: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.
verses.decoded: Now, priests, this instruction is meant specifically for you.

verses.kjv: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the Lord of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.
verses.decoded: If you refuse to listen and don't take it seriously to honor my name, says the LORD of hosts, I will send a curse on you and even curse your blessings. In fact, I have already cursed them because you haven't taken it seriously.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.
verses.decoded: Look, I will disgrace your descendants and scatter filth on your faces—even the filth from your sacred feasts—and you will be taken away with it.

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: You will understand that I gave you this instruction so that my covenant would remain with Levi, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.
verses.decoded: My covenant with him was about life and peace; I gave these because he respected me and was reverent toward my name.

verses.kjv: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.
verses.decoded: He spoke the truth and did not speak evil; he lived with me in peace and fairness, and he helped many turn away from sin.

verses.kjv: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: A priest’s lips should preserve knowledge, and people should seek the law from him because he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: But you have strayed from the right path; you have caused many to stumble over the law and have corrupted the covenant of Levi, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.
verses.decoded: Because you have not followed my ways and have shown favoritism in the law, I have made you a disgrace and lowly among all the people.

verses.kjv: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?
verses.decoded: Don’t we all have the same Father? Did not one God create us? Why then do we betray each other by breaking the covenant made with our ancestors?

verses.kjv: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the Lord which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.
verses.decoded: Judah has been unfaithful, and a terrible sin has been committed in Israel and Jerusalem: Judah has defiled the LORD’s holiness, whom he should love, by marrying women who worship foreign gods.

verses.kjv: The Lord will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: The LORD will remove the person who does this—both teacher and student—from the tents of Jacob, even those who offer sacrifices to the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the Lord with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth it with good will at your hand.
verses.decoded: You have done this again, making the altar of the LORD wet with tears, weeping, and crying out, so much that he no longer pays attention to your offerings or accepts them with favor.

verses.kjv: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
verses.decoded: But you ask, ‘Why?’ Because the LORD is a witness between you and the wife of your youth, whom you have been unfaithful to. She is your partner and the wife of your covenant.

verses.kjv: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
verses.decoded: Didn’t God make them one? He gave them a special spirit. Why one? So they could raise a godly family. So be careful with your spirit, and don’t be unfaithful to the wife of your youth.

verses.kjv: For the Lord, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the Lord of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.
verses.decoded: The LORD, the God of Israel, says He hates divorce, because it is like covering violence with a garment. So be careful with your attitude and do not be unfaithful.

verses.kjv: Ye have wearied the Lord with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the Lord, and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?
verses.decoded: You have tired the LORD with your words. But you ask, 'How have we tired Him?' By saying, 'Everyone who does evil is good in the LORD’s eyes, and He enjoys them,' or by asking, 'Where is the God who judges?'

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: Look, I will send my messenger ahead of me to prepare the way. Then the Lord you are seeking will come suddenly to his temple—the messenger of the covenant you desire. Yes, he is coming, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:
verses.decoded: But who can endure the day when he comes? Who can stand firm when he appears? He will be like a fire that refines and like soap that cleanses.

verses.kjv: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness.
verses.decoded: He will act like a refiner and purifier of silver, cleansing the descendants of Levi, refining them like gold and silver so they can offer righteous sacrifices to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the Lord, as in the days of old, and as in former years.
verses.decoded: Then the offerings from Judah and Jerusalem will please the LORD again, just like they did in the past, in former times.

verses.kjv: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: I will come close to judge you. I will quickly testify against sorcerers, adulterers, liars, those who cheat workers of their pay, oppress widows and orphans, deny justice to foreigners, and who do not respect me, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: For I am the Lord, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.
verses.decoded: I am the LORD, and I do not change; that is why you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.

verses.kjv: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the Lord of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?
verses.decoded: Since the time of your ancestors, you have turned away from my laws and have not obeyed them. Come back to me, and I will come back to you, says the LORD of hosts. But you ask, ‘How should we come back?’

verses.kjv: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
verses.decoded: Can anyone rob God? Yet you have robbed me. You ask, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

verses.kjv: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.
verses.decoded: You are under a curse because you have robbed me—all of you, the entire nation.

verses.kjv: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
verses.decoded: Bring all your tithes into the storehouse so there will be food in my temple. Test me in this, says the LORD of hosts, and see if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out so much blessing that you won’t have enough room to receive it.

verses.kjv: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: I will stop the destroyer from ruining your crops, and your vines will not drop their fruit prematurely in the field, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: All nations will call you blessed because you will be a land that is pleasing, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Your words have been stout against me, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?
verses.decoded: You have spoken arrogantly against me, says the LORD. Yet you ask, ‘What have we said against you?’

verses.kjv: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the Lord of hosts?
verses.decoded: You say, ‘It is useless to serve God. What do we gain by obeying his laws and going about like mourners before the LORD of hosts?’

verses.kjv: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.
verses.decoded: Now we say the proud are happy, those who do evil are successful, and those who test God get away with it.

verses.kjv: Then they that feared the Lord spake often one to another: and the Lord hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the Lord, and that thought upon his name.
verses.decoded: Those who respected the LORD spoke frequently among themselves; the LORD listened and heard them, and a record was kept of those who feared the LORD and remembered His name.

verses.kjv: And they shall be mine, saith the Lord of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty says, 'They will belong to me on the day I gather my treasured possessions, and I will protect them just like a father protects his obedient son.'

verses.kjv: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
verses.decoded: At that time, you will come back and clearly distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.

verses.kjv: For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
verses.decoded: Look, the day is coming that will burn like a hot oven. Everyone who is proud and does evil will be like dry grass that is completely burned up, says the LORD of Heaven’s Armies. It will destroy them completely, leaving nothing behind.

verses.kjv: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
verses.decoded: But for those who respect and honor my name, the Sun of righteousness will rise, bringing healing and restoration. You will go forward and grow strong like young calves released from the stall.

verses.kjv: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: You will overcome the wicked, because on that day they will be like ashes under your feet, says the LORD of Heaven’s Armies.

verses.kjv: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.
verses.decoded: Remember the law of Moses, my servant, which I gave him at Mount Horeb for all Israel, including the rules and regulations.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord:
verses.decoded: Look, I will send you the prophet Elijah before the great and terrible day of the LORD arrives.

verses.kjv: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
verses.decoded: He will help restore the relationship between parents and children, so that families are united, or else I will come and punish the earth with a curse.
